cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: You First
cards.instruction: Coax someone else into breaking a rule before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You pointed so confidently down that garden path. Step over the rope first and I'll come with you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was pointing at the staff-only sign. We're visitors.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, that's the entrance I meant. You can give them a friendly wave as you cross; I'll copy you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll have to open the gate for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll hold it from this side. You go through and wave; once they've waved back, I'll join you.
